fields.summary_ko.0: SpaceX (NASDAQ:SPCX) initially exceeded $200 post-IPO but has declined to the $140s; among 33 analysts, 27 maintain buy ratings, with consensus target of $246 suggesting 76% upside.
fields.summary_ko.1: Only CFRA Research's Keith Snyder holds a sell rating with $115 target; with AI representing $26.5T of SpaceX's $28.5T SAM, successful AI monetization is key to justifying high valuation.
